title: Create a group
summary: Makes a new group: the person picks people, gives a name and an optional photo, and the app creates an encrypted, invite-only group with them invited. A new group is quiet by default (group-quiet).

step.description: people: pick who joins. details: name and photo. creating: the room is being made. failed: see error.

query.description: The search field: a name, or an @ to look up.

suggestions.description: People from the person's DMs and groups, newest activity first, filtered by query. An @ query adds the account it resolves to.

selected.description: Who gets an invite. Can be empty: a group of one is allowed.

name.description: The group name. Required, trimmed, at most 255 characters.

photo.description: A local image picked for the group photo.

search.effect: Filters suggestions. Text that starts with @ or looks like a handle is resolved with GET /v1/handles/{handle}.

toggle.effect: Adds the person to selected or removes them.

create.effect: Uploads the photo if any (Client.uploadMedia), then Client.createRoom with name, isEncrypted true, isDirect false, visibility private, preset PrivateChat, avatar and the selected user IDs in invite. On success opens chat-timeline for the new group. Off while the trimmed name is empty.

notes: Every group is encrypted (e2ee-only-rooms). There is no public or knock-to-join group in phase 1, no room address and no community (communities are phase 3).

The @ lookup goes to bipe-api, never a Matrix user directory search, so an @ is the way to find someone not in the person's chats. Bipe logic: BipeHandleResolver.userID(forHandle:) (iOS), BipeHandleResolver (Android).
The name is required because a group with no name would show its members' names, which leaks who is in it to anyone who sees the list.
The empty state of the Groups tab (bipe_groups_empty_title, bipe_groups_empty_body, bipe_groups_empty_action) opens this screen.
